name: attach
desc:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to it. While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is attached, the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't make Bite attacks against other targets. In addition, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within [[lookup @range.value activity=6iLqAufAeEqDOlGs]] feet of it can take an action to try to detach the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, doing so by succeeding on a DC [[lookup @check.dc.value activity=6iLqAufAeEqDOlGs]] Strength (Athletics) check.
